aiSuggest.title: detect grape leaf disease
aiSuggest.description: Upload a grape leaf image so AI can analyze likely disease signals and highlight the area it focused on.
aiSuggest.focusMapHint: Hotter areas show where the model paid more attention before making its prediction.
aiSuggest.focusMapUnavailable: No focus map could be generated for this image.

treatments.healthy: No clear disease signs were detected in this image. Keep monitoring, maintain dry airflow around the canopy, and water at the base.
treatments.downyMildew: This may be downy mildew. Remove affected leaves, keep the area well ventilated, avoid wetting the foliage, and inspect further if it spreads quickly.
treatments.esca: This may be Esca wood disease. Check the trunk and branches, remove clearly infected parts when confirmed, and consult a specialist if needed.
treatments.leafBlight: This may be leaf blight. Remove affected leaves, reduce moisture on the canopy, and monitor before taking stronger action.
treatments.blackrot: This may be black rot. Collect diseased leaves or fruit, keep the area dry and airy, and inspect early if it appears on young fruit.
treatments.leafRoll: This may be leaf roll. Check watering, nutrition, and sap-sucking pests; if symptoms persist, inspect the plant on site.
treatments.invalidLeaf: The image is not suitable for identification. Please take a clear close-up of a grape leaf with good lighting and no obstruction.
treatments.invalidImage: The image could not be opened. Please try again with a clear JPG or PNG file.
treatments.unknown: Confidence is too low. Please retake a clearer photo or verify the plant in person before acting.
treatments.processingError: Please try again with another image.
